notes: Stop signatures for job boards (design 4.5, row 'Any job site'). The breaker scope is the payload platform (site:<name>). Same regex rules as linkedin.json. A login wall or login page is an expired session (site_logged_out: log in or copy the login again); a CAPTCHA, block or verification is site_challenge, which wins when both match (detect.SEVERITY).

signatures.text: captcha|verify (that )?you.re (a )?human|are you a robot|security check|press and hold
unusual activity|unusual traffic|access denied|temporarily blocked|too many requests
log ?in to continue|sign in to (apply|continue|view)|please log ?in|session (has )?expired

error_after_click.text: something went wrong|try again later|could not (apply|submit)|failed to (apply|submit)|an error occurred
